author: PayTona
quote: Personally, something just feels off about this game. The whole concept of an annoying, weird guy doing everything for his bossy, "best in the world" woman is terrible-it lowkey feels more like a modern Netflix series than a GTA **** gameplay has no soul, the story mode is boring, and nothing makes me want to come back to it. The missions are okay, sure, but nowhere near as fun as in previous titles. It doesn't even feel like real gaming-it completely lacks the soul of GTA V or San Andreas, which I've **** can't I just do whatever I want? Why can't I pull off a heist whenever I feel like it? Even driving is boring now. The cars just feel like generic cars, not machines with soul that you actually want to drive. I went back to GTA V and realized how differently time passes: 1 hour in GTA V feels like 15 minutes, while in GTA VI it feels like 999 hours. Such a disappointment.
